thread:
Sam: FYI remote_write queue for prometheus-prod-east is blowing up, p95 write latency >30s and we're getting client timeout errors to cortex.
Dara: ugh, saw same. Started ~10m after the gpu-exporter rollout in eu-west2. Think the exporter added pod annotations with GPU serials -> cardinality explosion :/ 
Sam: logs: \n```
level=error ts=2026-03-18T10:12:34.123Z caller=remote.go:214 component=remote level=error msg="remote write failed" err="Post \"https://cortex-internal:9009/api/prom/push\": net/http: request canceled (Client.Timeout exceeded while awaiting headers)"
```
Natalie: can we confirm series growth? run `curl -s "http://prometheus-prod-east:9090/api/v1/series?match[]=gpu_temperature_celsius" | jq length` — on prod it's jumped from ~1200 -> 180k for that metric namespace.
Chris: yep that's consistent with pod annotation labels being attached to metrics. Quick mitigation: drop those labels at scrape/remote_write.
Dara: proposed immediate change (canary to one replica): add this under the scrape job or remote_write: \n```
metric_relabel_configs:
- action: labeldrop
  regex: gpu_id|device_serial
```
Sam: or at remote_write level (faster to patch prometheus config live): \n```
remote_write:
- url: https://cortex-internal:9009/api/prom/push
  timeout: 30s
  write_relabel_configs:
  - action: labeldrop
    regex: gpu_id|device_serial
```
Natalie: note: labeldrop will remove labels from ALL metrics sent via that remote_write block. That's ok for short term but we should scope it to the gpu-exporter job if possible.
Chris: alternative scoped rule at scrape level for gpu-exporter: \n```
job_name: kube-gpu-exporter
  static_configs: ...
  metric_relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: [__name__]
    regex: "gpu_.*"
    action: keep
  - action: labeldrop
    regex: gpu_id|device_serial
```
Sam: going to patch prometheus-staging with the remote_write write_relabel_configs and test.
oncall-bot: @Sam created a rollout: prometheus-staging configpatch -> write_relabel_configs (canary) ; CI passed
Dara: also we should silence the noisy alerts while we stabilize — RemoteWriteFailedHigh and PrometheusQueueLength -> add a 1h silence for the production alert group while rolling.
Natalie: long-term: ask gpu-exporter team to stop exporting device serials as labels (PII-ish) and instead expose a hashed id or only expose device type. I'll open an RFC.
Chris: after canary looks good, plan: 1) apply write_relabel_configs to prod remote_write 2) scale scrape interval for gpu-exporter from 15s -> 30s temporarily 3) monitor series count + write queue length
Sam: quick commands I'm running: \n```
kubectl --context=prod -n monitoring exec -it prometheus-0 -- promtool tsdb analyze /prometheus | grep Series
curl -s "http://prometheus-prod-east:9090/api/v1/status/flags" | jq
```
Dara: I'm also going to add a short grafana panel (prod-scrape-health) to show series-by-job and last scrape duration so we can watch regressions.
prom-bot: Alert RemoteWriteFailedHigh -> ACK by Sam
Sam: can someone own postmortem with timeline + cost estimate? I can draft but need export of series count deltas from prometheus for last 3h.
Natalie: I'll own the PM side + RFC to exporter team. Chris can follow up on alert tuning.
Sam: patch merged to staging, canary looks good, series dropped from 180k -> 1.5k for gpu metrics. planning prod patch in 3m.
Dara: 👍 leave the silence in place until tomorrow morning, then measure for 24h before fully rolling back silence.
Chris: deploying prod patch now.
oncall-bot: Rollout started: prometheus-prod configpatch write_relabel_configs -> target=prometheus-prod-0
Sam: prod patch applied. write queue length back to normal, no more timeouts. leaving thread open until grafana panels report stable for 1h.
Natalie: thanks all — follow-ups: RFC for exporter (not emitting serials), audit of other exporters that add pod annotations to metrics, and add a short runbook entry for 'label explosion' -> relabel steps.
Sam: nice work :thumbsup:
notes: mitigation, relabel configs, canary->prod patch, alert silencing, follow-up RFC
